title: Multi-step shape problems: perimeter and area

blocks.content: Some shape problems need two ideas at once — perimeter (the distance around) and area (the space inside). Take them one at a time.
Perimeter is the total distance around a shape. For a rectangle, add the length and width, then double it: 2 x (length + width).

steps: A rectangle is 5 cm by 3 cm.

blocks.prompt: A 5 cm by 3 cm rectangle has perimeter 2 x (5 + 3) = ___ cm
blocks.rule: Perimeter of a rectangle = 2 x (length + width).

practiceItems.prompt: perimeter of a 4 by 2 rectangle: 2 x (4 + 2)
perimeter of a square with side 5: 4 x 5
perimeter of a square with side 3

blocks.content: Area is the space inside a shape. For a rectangle, multiply length by width.

blocks.prompt: Area of a 5 cm by 3 cm rectangle = 5 x 3 = ___ square cm
blocks.explain: Area = length x width = 5 x 3 = 15 square cm.
blocks.rule: Area of a rectangle = length x width.

practiceItems.prompt: area of a square with side 5
area of a square with side 4

blocks.content: Perimeter adds up all the sides; area multiplies length by width. Keep the two ideas separate and work step by step. Let's practise!
